title: Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements: Cancellation Windows, Restocking Charges and Refund Terms by Plan
content:
# Cancellation windows, restocking charges and refunds — Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements

Your agreement under Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements carries a cancellation window, a restocking charge for a cancellation after that window, a share of your payments returned should the agreement forfeit, and a method and a timing for any refund. The figures for each plan are set out here.

| Plan | Cancellation window (calendar days after opening) | Restocking share of the merchandise price | Ceiling on the restocking charge (USD) | Share of what was paid returned on forfeit | Refund method | Refund issued within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hold Agreement | 3 | 0 percent | 0.00 | 100 percent | original tender | 3 |
| 90-Day Layaway | 7 | 10 percent | 150.00 | 75 percent | original tender | 5 |
| 6-Month Layaway | 10 | 12 percent | 350.00 | 70 percent | original tender | 5 |
| 12-Month Bridal Layaway | 14 | 15 percent | 750.00 | 65 percent | original tender | 7 |
| Special Order Layaway | 3 | 25 percent | 1500.00 | 25 percent | store credit | 10 |
| Gift Registry Layaway | 10 | 12 percent | 500.00 | 70 percent | store credit | 7 |

## Your questions answered

**How is my refund paid?** On the 30-Day Hold Agreement, the 90-Day Layaway, the 6-Month Layaway and the 12-Month Bridal Layaway, to the original tender. On the Special Order Layaway and the Gift Registry Layaway, as store credit.

**How soon is it issued?** Within the plan's number of business days shown above: 3 on the 30-Day Hold Agreement, 5 on the 90-Day Layaway and the 6-Month Layaway, 7 on the 12-Month Bridal Layaway and the Gift Registry Layaway, and 10 on the Special Order Layaway.

**What is the restocking share read against?** The merchandise price. The charge never exceeds the plan's ceiling however the share works out. The 30-Day Hold Agreement keeps nothing.

**What comes back if the agreement forfeits?** The plan's share of what you paid: all of it on the 30-Day Hold Agreement, and 75, 70, 65, 25 and 70 percent respectively on the 90-Day Layaway, the 6-Month Layaway, the 12-Month Bridal Layaway, the Special Order Layaway and the Gift Registry Layaway.
